# Vendored xterm.js

Pinned copies of the xterm.js UMD builds, loaded via `<script src>` (no build
step, no npm). Update by re-downloading from jsDelivr at the pinned versions
and re-running the smoke test (vim + htop + `cargo build` render correctly).

| File | Package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xterm.js` | `@xterm/xterm` | `5.5.0` |
| `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` | `5.5.0` |
| `xterm-addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` | `0.10.0` |
| `LICENSE` | `@xterm/xterm` | (MIT) |

Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<pkg>@<ver>/lib/<file>` (UMD build).
